Footer.desc: Digital full-cycle operator for car imports from US auctions. Transparent pricing, real timelines, turnkey cost.

ctaBand.title: Enter parameters — and in 30 seconds you'll see the turnkey price.
ctaBand.subtitle: No registration, no obligations. The calculator shows all payments — auction, shipping, customs, our service — to the dollar.

faq.title: Things we get asked most often.
faq.subtitle: Didn't find an answer? Message a manager — we'll respond within a few hours.

items.question: How long does it take to bring a car from the USA?
items.answer: On average 60–80 days from the moment of purchase at auction: 30–45 days for sea shipping, 5–10 days for customs clearance, and 10–25 days for restoration. The exact timeline depends on the port of departure, chosen vessel, and scope of repairs.

items.question: What taxes and fees will I pay under Ukrainian law?
items.answer: Customs duty (0% for EVs, 10% for all others), excise tax (calculated in EUR based on engine size and car age), and VAT at 20%. All amounts are calculated before the auction and shown in the full cost breakdown — no surprises.

items.question: Can I see the condition of the car before purchase at auction?
items.answer: Yes. We provide the full Copart or IAAI lot page with all available photos, condition report, and VIN history. You approve the specific lot before we bid.

items.question: What happens if my car arrives with additional damage?
items.answer: During ocean shipping, the car is insured. If damage occurs in transit, we handle the insurance claim on your behalf and coordinate repairs at our workshop — at no extra cost to you.

items.question: Can I return the car if something is wrong?
items.answer: After purchase at auction, the car cannot be returned to the seller — this is standard for US auto auctions. That's exactly why we provide a full cost breakdown and photos before you approve any lot. If a defect is discovered during restoration that wasn't in the auction listing, we document it and discuss options with you transparently.

items.question: How are payments structured — by stage or all at once?
items.answer: In stages: you pay the auction bid and fees first, then sea shipping, then customs duties, then restoration. Each payment is agreed and documented in advance — you never pay a lump sum upfront.

items.question: Can I fly to inspect the car before customs clearance?
items.answer: Yes, you can visit our yard after the car arrives in Ukraine and before customs clearance. We'll arrange the inspection and walk you through the condition of the vehicle in person.

items.question: What guarantees do you provide?
items.answer: We guarantee full transparency of all costs before purchase, photo and video documentation at every stage, and restoration work performed only with your written approval. We do not provide a manufacturer-style warranty on used auction vehicles — but we do stand behind the quality of our restoration work.

items.question: Is there a discount if I buy multiple cars?
items.answer: Yes, we offer individual terms for clients ordering multiple vehicles. Contact a manager to discuss the details.

items.question: Can I track the car in real time?
items.answer: Yes. After registration in your personal dashboard, you can track the current status of your order at any time — from auction purchase through delivery. Key updates are also sent via Telegram notifications.

items.question: What about repairs — do you handle restoration or do I need to arrange it separately?
items.answer: We have our own restoration workshop. After arrival, our technicians assess the car and prepare a repair estimate. You review and approve the scope before any work begins. You can also decline restoration and take the car as-is after customs clearance.

items.question: Can I register it with Ukrainian plates, or does it need Polish plates?
items.answer: Ukrainian plates. We handle full customs clearance in Ukraine — the car receives a Ukrainian customs declaration and can be registered with the traffic police (Service Centre of the Ministry of Internal Affairs) for standard Ukrainian number plates.

testimonials.title: What clients say.
testimonials.item1Text: I was skeptical at first — importing a car from the USA seemed complicated and risky. But the team explained every step clearly, all costs were laid out before the auction, and I could watch the restoration process online. The car arrived on time and in better condition than I expected. I'll definitely recommend VitAuto to anyone considering this.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.step1Desc: We analyze Copart and IAAI lots based on your budget, requirements, and condition preferences — and present options for your approval.
howItWorks.step2Desc: We bid on your behalf and purchase the lot. You receive full auction documents and payment confirmation.
howItWorks.step3Desc: The car is loaded at a US port and shipped by container vessel to Odesa, Ukraine.
howItWorks.step4Desc: We handle all customs paperwork — duties, excise, and VAT — and provide a full itemised cost breakdown.
howItWorks.step5Desc: Repair and detailing at our own workshop. You approve the work scope and cost before anything begins.
howItWorks.step6Desc: The car is delivered with all documents, Ukrainian registration, and plates — ready to drive.

benefits.title: Why VitAuto
benefits.item1Desc: All costs are calculated before the auction. The price you see is the price you pay — no surprises.
benefits.item2Desc: From auction lot photos to restoration progress — everything is visible in your personal dashboard.
benefits.item3Desc: Exchange rates and duty calculations are updated daily at the NBU exchange rate.
benefits.item4Desc: A dedicated manager guides you through every step and answers your questions at any stage.
benefits.item5Desc: Quality controlled in-house — no third-party workshops, no hidden markups on repairs.
benefits.item6Desc: We deliver to Kyiv, Lviv, Odesa, and other cities — straight to your door.
